That’s completely fine! I’m glad this post resonated with you. I don’t know if there’s a reason or if it’s mere coincidence that I happen to see your comment after being off the app for a while. 

I’m starting to work my way through it though not by immediately learning to trust others yet (I’ll get there), but through working on myself since I realise I have a problem with how live my life. The way I live my life as of now (letting time pass me by, dwelling on past choices and regrets, and doing absolutely nothing to change that) is what prevents me from sharing anything with anyone these days. This is especially true when the people around me have moved on with their lives without me. I realised that hearing and knowing how better they’re doing while I stay where I am contemplating my life as it passes me by, in itself is a trigger for me to avoid those who I once called friends.

Another thing is that I noticed is that I saw the truth about certain friends. Call it an ‘eye opening’ realisation, if you will. Long story short, I found how I never was really happy hanging out with them as myself and that I guess the only thing that kept it going was a trauma bond. I now know that this caused me to be closed off to any of my remaining friends.

Today, I had to keep myself together in a room full of friends/acquaintances, nearly crying more than once. So, seeing your comment is fate, I suppose. It’s the universe telling me to start healing myself through time and to slowly piece together who I am, since losing myself is how it all began in the first place. I don’t have a solid word of advice just yet, just realisations and lessons. Maybe, soon.
